title: Reviewing compliance.
bodyText: Compliance with the prudent investor rule is determined in light of the facts and circumstances existing at the time of a trustee's decision or action and not by hindsight.
bodyHtml: [§554D-905]  Reviewing compliance.  Compliance with the prudent investor rule is determined in light of the facts and circumstances existing at the time of a trustee's decision or action and not by hindsight. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
